summary: Three independently reconstructed adversarial controls confirm that the H27 value, rho restrictions and actual deletion-set inclusion are essential. The manuscript and inspected implementations retain those distinctions. No counterexample to the stated guarded implications was found. The external provenance and shared-builder limitations remain; agreement among reviewers supplies no additional mathematical premise.
